form.label: LinkedIn Assistant
form.description: Drop a LinkedIn export ZIP into the server inbox shown in Setup & inbox. Dashboards switch automatically after indexed record counts reconcile. Dates labeled import_observed describe when the snapshot was received.

search.query: index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:* earliest=0 latest=+10y | search member_id=* | stats count BY member_id | eval member_label=if(member_id="personal","Personal",member_id) | fields member_id member_label

index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:ready earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=ready member_id=$member|s$ | dedup export_id | sort - import_epoch | eval label=snapshot_time." — ".status | fields label export_id
index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:ready earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=ready member_id=$member|s$ | dedup export_id | sort - import_epoch | head 1 | fields export_id

index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:ready earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=ready member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | dedup export_id | table snapshot_time snapshot_time_basis status actual_records warning_count export_id
`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=connection | stats count AS Connections
`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=job_application | stats count AS Applications
`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=endorsement_received | stats count AS Endorsements

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=learning | where isnotnull(content_completed_at_if_completed) AND content_completed_at_if_completed!="" AND content_completed_at_if_completed!="N/A" | stats count AS Completed
`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | stats count AS records BY dataset | sort - records

index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:manifest earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=manifest member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | dedup export_id dataset | table dataset source_rows expected_records excluded_rows duplicate_rows quarantined_rows date_issues
